gloss: to become familiar with, to feel close to

definitions.gloss: to become familiar with, to become friendly with, to feel close to
definitions.explanation: To develop familiarity, affection, or comfort with something or someone over time. Often used with activities, nature, culture, or people to express a warm sense of closeness.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}のころから{音楽|おんがく}に{親|した}しんできた。
examples.english: I've been familiar with music since childhood.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{人|ひと}に{親|した}しまれている{祭|まつ}りが、{今年|ことし}も{開催|かいさい}される。
examples.english: The festival beloved by many people will be held again this year.

notes:
USAGE:
{親|した}しむ means to feel close to or enjoy something over time. The passive form {親|した}しまれる (to be loved/enjoyed by many) is extremely common. Do not confuse with {親|した}しい (adjective: close, intimate, friendly), though they share the same root.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自然|しぜん}に{親|した}しむ: to enjoy/appreciate nature
- {文化|ぶんか}に{親|した}しむ: to become familiar with culture
- {親|した}しまれる: to be loved/enjoyed (by many)
- {広|ひろ}く{親|した}しまれている: widely beloved
- {読書|どくしょ}に{親|した}しむ: to enjoy reading
